hook: A new starlight model makes JWST planet imaging 2 to 15 times more sensitive.
summary: Imaging a planet means removing the star's glare, which standard methods do with reference images that drift out of date. This method fits a physical model of the instrument with millions of parameters using automatic differentiation. On JWST NIRCam coronagraph data it beat standard techniques by 2 to 15 times and detected 51 Eridani b at 4.3 microns for the first time. It was shown on JWST observations only, not yet other telescopes.
title: Imaging exoplanets below the telescope stability limit
